groups.title: Match the Sentence Parts - Relative Clauses

sentences.full_sentence: This is the bank which was robbed yesterday
sentences.translation: هذا هو البنك الذي سُرق أمس.

sentences.start: My parents bought a new house
sentences.full_sentence: My parents bought a new house that was very expensive
sentences.translation: اشترى والداي منزلاً جديداً كان باهظ الثمن.

sentences.start: The woman whose car was broken
sentences.full_sentence: The woman whose car was broken is my neighbour
sentences.translation: المرأة التي تعطلت سيارتها هي جارتي.

sentences.start: My sister teaches in a school
sentences.full_sentence: My sister teaches in a school where we all studied
sentences.translation: أختي تدرس في مدرسة درسنا فيها جميعاً.

sentences.full_sentence: He arrived at seven when it was nearly dark
sentences.translation: وصل في الساعة السابعة عندما كان الظلام قد حل تقريباً.

groups.title: Match the Sentence Parts - An Active Citizen

options.text: an important skill of good citizens.
what is black tonight turns white in the morning.

sentences.start: Encouraging Susan to finish her studies was
sentences.full_sentence: Encouraging Susan to finish her studies was the advice of her father
sentences.translation: كان تشجيع سوزان لإنهاء دراستها نصيحة والدها.

sentences.start: To make her daughter feel comfortable,
sentences.full_sentence: To make her daughter feel comfortable, Susan's mother works hard
sentences.translation: لجعل ابنتها تشعر بالراحة، تعمل والدة سوزان بجد.

sentences.full_sentence: Susan believes that what is black tonight turns white in the morning
sentences.translation: تعتقد سوزان أن ما هو أسود الليلة يتحول إلى أبيض في الصباح.

sentences.start: Working for the welfare of society is
sentences.full_sentence: Working for the welfare of society is an important skill of good citizens
sentences.translation: العمل من أجل رفاهية المجتمع هو مهارة مهمة للمواطنين الصالحين.

sentences.start: She urges people of her age
sentences.full_sentence: She urges people of her age to work for welfare services
sentences.translation: إنها تحث الناس في عمرها على العمل في خدمات الرعاية الاجتماعية.
